ValidationRule.description: Date TCM User Created cannot be a date in the Future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: New Customer Setup" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_TCM_User_Created__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_TCM_User_Created__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_TCM_User_Created__c ) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_TCM_User_Created__c )) || DATEVALUE(Date_TCM_User_Created__c ) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_TCM_User_Created__c )) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_TCM_User_Created__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_TCM_User_Created__c ) > TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date TCM User Created cannot be a date in the Future.
